final_text:
Fictional Customer 010 had the highest sales from 2026-02-01 to 2026-02-28 (dates inclusive), at 3,275.27.

**Source:** product DAILY_INVOICED_SALES, released version 201, table `HACKATHON_D2K_PREWORK.L2P_RELEASE.DAILY_INVOICED_SALES_V0201`. The product's data covers 2026-01-05 to 2026-03-03, so all of February is included.

**Sales measure:** invoiced sales excluding tax, which is each invoice line's extended price minus its tax amount, added up. The product doesn't record a currency, so the amounts have no currency symbol.

| Rank | Customer ID | Customer Name | Sales Excl. Tax | Invoice Lines | Distinct Items | Active Days | First Invoice | Last Invoice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 10 | Fictional Customer 010 | 3,275.27 | 10 | 9 | 4 | 2026-02-03 | 2026-02-22 |
| 2 | 18 | Fictional Customer 018 | 2,787.78 | 14 | 10 | 5 | 2026-02-04 | 2026-02-26 |
| 3 | 8 | Fictional Customer 008 | 2,600.14 | 10 | 8 | 4 | 2026-02-07 | 2026-02-20 |

Customer 018 had the most invoice lines and active days but still placed second on sales value.

**What this ranking can't show:** it is based only on invoiced sales. The product has no data on marketing consent, campaign response, margin or causal uplift. So this list can't show whether a customer may be contacted, how profitable they are, or whether any campaign affected their sales. Returns and discounts aren't in the product either.
